messages:
alex: hey team, first week hello! i'm setting up observability for infra-eu and hit a few access issues. i can view the EU Grafana dashboards but the Edit button is greyed out. Datadog's API keys page says "Insufficient permissions" when i try to create a scoped key, and Sentry for infra-eu returns a 403. who manages EU-region access for Grafana/Datadog/Sentry?

rachel: welcome @alex :wave: region-specific stuff can be confusing. devex handles Grafana roles via the access portal, Datadog keys are handled by the monitoring team, and Sentry invites usually come from the project owner or @elena. since this is EU infra, include the region tag (eu-west) in your request so we grant the right org-scoped roles.

elena: hi @alex  i can send the Sentry invite but i need the exact SSO email and the project slug (sometimes infra-eu-prod vs infra-eu). if you're hitting 403 it's usually org-mapping — confirm you signed in with the company SSO (@redwood.eu or @redwood.dev via SSO). DM me the email and i'll add you to infra-eu-prod.

oliver: for Datadog, we restrict API key creation in EU to scoped keys created via the portal to comply with regional controls. request the role "Datadog Scoped Key (EU)" in the access portal and include justification like "onboarding: create monitor for infra-eu". If you need a short-lived key for local testing request TTL 7 days. For automation use the datadog-ops-eu service account.

devex-bot: To request Grafana Editor for EU dashboards: https://internal.redwood.com/access-requests -> select "Grafana Editor" -> add team tag (eng-eu) -> include folder name "platform-dashboards-eu" and justification (onboarding: infra-eu dashboard edits). For Datadog Scoped Key (EU) pick the region option. Typical approval 1-2 business days. React with :rocket: for expedited review.

eng-oncall: @alex if these issues are generating production alert noise, include "prod-impact" in your access requests and CC @eng-oncall. We can temporarily mute noisy monitors during onboarding changes. Once you have edit access paste the Grafana panel link here and we'll do a quick sanity-check.

alex: thanks all  i've DM'd @elena with alex@redwood.eu and requested Grafana Editor + Datadog Scoped Key (EU) via the portal with note "onboarding: infra-eu CPU alert tuning". added prod-impact. one quick Q: are EU dashboards copied from global ones or are they distinct so i should expect different panel IDs?

rachel: EU dashboards are mostly region-specific copies but sometimes share templates. panel IDs differ; when you paste the panel link include the dashboard UID so we can find the canonical template. also add a one-line entry to the alert-change log (link in onboarding docs) when you change thresholds.

elena: invite sent to alex@redwood.eu. accept via SSO and you should see the Sentry project.

alex: accepted Sentry invite, thanks! i'll wait for Grafana/Datadog approval and post links once i can edit. appreciate the help :thumbsup:

oliver: once you have edit rights, if you plan to lower CPU alert sensitivity start with a small window (15m) and tag the change with team:eng-eu so oncall can filter. If needed we can mute for a short rollout.

rachel: welcome aboard and ping if anything else blocks. documentation for EU onboarding is here: https://docs.redwood.com/obs/eu-onboarding (contains folder names, team tags, and alert-change process).
